scope: Local artifact integrity and normalized text-containment audit; no inference.
comparison_rule: Casefold Unicode word characters (including underscores), joining tokens with spaces. Check whether the complete normalized diagnostic is a word-bounded substring of normalized source text. Empty normalized texts are rejected.
limitations: No semantic or paraphrase overlap exclusion is established.
Diagnostic questions were previously inspected, not a blind test.
Local hashes do not substitute for a remote run-output hash manifest.
These checks do not evaluate answer quality or resolve token-limit censoring.
